understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one grid cell per directional action, with walls and boundaries blocking movement. Adjacent pushable blocks can be moved by pushing them, while selectable pieces can be switched using CLICK at their pixel/grid coordinates. Movement hints are heuristic and clicks may fail or consume steps without changing position.
